research_rationale: EO 12194 (signed 1980-02-21, 45 FR 12209), read in full from the held FR text, establishes the Radiation Policy Council to coordinate Federal radiation protection policy (sec. 1-1), sets its functions (1-2) and administration (1-3) and ends it 'four years after the date of this Order' (1-303). The machine own-term kinds are report_deadlines (1-203 annual report, 1-303 final annual report); neither is an end. The one stated date (four years from 1980-02-21 = 1984-02-21) falls after EO 12379 sec. 23 (47 FR 36099; reading record research/excavator/lambertini-2026-10-20/readings/LSP-EO_12379.json, whose text sha256 c7c738d02047e0faabb73bdca7b9cbf5cb9953abb67a629f658cb125eb3f1613 was re-verified on disk) revoked the order, effective on signing 1982-08-17, so the revocation is the first end. A by-number scan of all 6,652 held FR-original texts finds EO 12194 named only in EO 12379; there is no extension order and no amendment. The dossier's other actor provisions (ACT:EO:12194>EO:11022, >EO:11256, >EO:11829) are ruled out as spurious, as P1 found: their text is the EO 12379 sentence, copied from source-ladder queue files for 47 FR 36099-36100 attached to those three orders, and the held FR texts of EO 11022 (27 FR 4659), EO 11256 (30 FR 14137) and EO 11829 (40 FR 1497) never name EO 12194.
